newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota says no comment on Slovakia car plant talks.
newsitem.headline: Toyota says no comment on Slovakia car plant talks.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp on Tuesday declined to comment on news overnight that Slovakia's biggest steel maker, VSZ a.s., is in preliminary talks with a Japanese carmaker on building a car assembly plant in Slovakia.
After a trip to Japan at the beginning of April, Slovakia's Finance Minister Sergei Kozlik said Toyota was considering locating a car production plant in eastern Slovakia.
"We cannot make any comments. At this moment, we cannot comment on the details of our study for a possible second car plant in Europe," a Toyota spokesman said.
"Toyota is now considering whether it needs new investment in Europe and is collecting information in several European countries," the spokesman added.
VSZ said on Monday that it was in preliminary negotiations with an unspecified Japanese carmaker on building a car assembly plant in Slovakia.
Toyota president Hiroshi Okuda left Japan on May 5 to visit Toyota Motor Europe in Brussels and will return home on May 10 after visiting Toyota South Africa Ltd.
In October last year, Toyota bought a 27.8 percent stake in Toyota South Africa for 446 million rand from Johnnies Industrial Corp Ltd (Johnnic).
